# pakmap settings reference

Every reader of pakmap meets the same configuration and the same write rules. One engine (`src/settings/`) resolves defaults < user file < project file, then serves three doors over one catalog:

- **CLI** — `pakmap config {list,get,set,unset,validate,path,docs}`
- **TUI** — press `S` (settings modal): filter, Space toggles, Enter edits, `r` resets a row, `s` saves, `e` opens `$EDITOR`
- **GUI** — the Settings screen (gear button or `s`)

All three render origins, apply tags, and danger rows from the tables below; the CLI and the GUI write through the same engine, the TUI writes the user file only.

## Example config (generated)

```toml
# pakmap config — edit and save, changes apply on next launch
# See: https://github.com/kenjaku-dev/pakmap  — all fields optional

[search]
limit = 50                # max results per source; 0 = no limit
source = "all"            # where to search: aur|repo|flatpak|all
by = "name-desc"          # AUR search field
regex = false             # treat queries as regex
installed_only = false    # show only installed packages (repo side)
timeout_secs = 15         # AUR/http timeout seconds (clamped 3..=30)
bottom_up = false         # print results bottom-up (AUR first); [behavior] bottom_up is a deprecated alias


[tui]
# numbers are columns/rows; floor_* is the TUI minimum size
enabled = true            # launch the TUI when stdin/stdout are terminals
floor_width = 60          # minimum terminal width for the TUI (columns)
floor_height = 14         # minimum terminal height for the TUI (rows)
layout_search = 3         # search bar height (rows)
layout_results_min = 8    # minimum results height (rows)
border = "rounded"        # panel border style
highlight_symbol = ""     # selected-row marker (empty = "▸ " default, plain none)
show_tabs = true          # show the Search/Installed tab bar
preview_pane = false      # show a preview pane next to the list (desktop widths; narrower terminals keep the `i` info modal)
popup_info = [70, 60]     # info popup size (cols,rows)
popup_confirm = [60, 30]  # confirm popup size (cols,rows)
popup_message = [60, 20]  # message popup size (cols,rows)
popup_help = [70, 60]     # help popup size (cols,rows)
tick_chars = ""           # spinner characters (empty = braille default)
spinner_template = ""     # indicatif spinner template (empty = "{spinner:.cyan} {msg}")
debounce_ms = 400         # search-as-you-type debounce ms (clamped 50..=5000)
poll_ms = 200             # event poll interval ms (clamped 50..=1000)


[theme]
# styles: "fg [on bg] [modifiers]", e.g. "black on cyan bold"
no_color = false          # disable colored output (mirrors --no-color)
border_focused = "cyan"   # focused panel border style
border_unfocused = "dark_gray"# unfocused panel border style
border_error = "red bold" # error panel border style
text = "white"            # regular text style
text_dim = "dark_gray"    # dimmed/hint text style
repo_core = "red bold"    # core repo tag style
repo_extra = "green bold" # extra repo tag style
repo_multilib = "blue bold"# multilib repo tag style
repo_aur = "magenta bold" # AUR tag style
repo_other = "cyan bold"  # other repo tag style
repo_local = "green bold" # local/pushed repo tag style
installed = "green bold"  # installed-package marker style
out_of_date = "red bold"  # out-of-date marker style
votes = "yellow"          # AUR vote count style
version = "white"         # version column style
highlight_bg = "dark_gray"# selection background
highlight_fg = "white bold"# selection foreground
status_loading = "cyan"   # loading status-line style
status_idle = "gray"      # idle status-line style
help = "dark_gray"        # help/hint line style
popup_title = "yellow"    # popup title style
popup_bg = "black"        # popup background
tab_selected = "black on cyan bold"# selected tab style
tab_normal = "dark_gray"  # inactive tab style


[behavior]
# PAKMAP_NOCONFIRM=1 in the environment also enables the noconfirm
# flags below (and skips --remove/--refresh) — handy for scripts.
# NOTE: [search] bottom_up is the canonical spelling; an old
# [behavior] bottom_up is still accepted as a deprecated alias.
verbose = 0               # verbosity level 0..=2 (mirrors -v counts)
aur_rpc = ""              # AUR RPC base URL override (http/https; blank = default) — trust only your own file
cache_dir = ""            # AUR clone/cache dir override (blank = XDG cache) — must be your own dir
makepkg_noconfirm = false # pass --noconfirm to makepkg builds
remove_flags = "Rs"       # pacman remove flags (allowlist R|Rs|Rns|Ru|Rsu|Rn|Rc|Rdd)
remove_noconfirm = false  # add --noconfirm to package removal
refresh_noconfirm = false # add --noconfirm to database refresh (pacman -Sy)
readonly = false          # refuse install/remove/refresh/upgrade (safe browse mode)
news_enabled = true       # Arch-news intervention guard before upgrade
news_cache_secs = 86400   # news cache TTL seconds
diff_pager = ""           # PKGBUILD diff pager: auto|bat|less|cat (blank = auto)
upgrade_noconfirm = false # add --noconfirm to system upgrade
clean_keep = 2            # versions kept per package on cache clean (paccache -k, min 1)
clean_noconfirm = false   # non-interactive clean (sudo -n, fails fast)
flatpak_enabled = true    # enable the flatpak backend (fail-open when binary absent)
flatpak_remote = ""       # remote for flatpak install/search (blank = flathub)
flatpak_noconfirm = false # pass -y to flatpak install/remove/clean


[gui]
# applies on next launch; "device" keeps today's behavior
theme = "device"          # GUI theme: device|system|light|dark (device = current behavior)

# Environment variables (read-only session knobs, not file keys):
#   PAKMAP_NOCONFIRM, PAKMAP_TRUST_PROJECT, PAKMAP_SKIP_LIVE,
#   PAKMAP_GUI_SMOKE_MS, PAKMAP_GUI_FPBUDGET_MS — see `pakmap config list`.
```

## Keys (67 settings + 5 env knobs)

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `search.source` | Search | enum(all/aur/repo/flatpak) | `all` | immediate | - | where to search: aur\|repo\|flatpak\|all |
| `search.by` | Search | enum(name-desc/name/maintainer/depends/makedepends/optdepends/checkdepends) | `name-desc` | immediate | - | AUR search field |
| `search.regex` | Search | bool | `false` | immediate | - | treat queries as regex |
| `search.installed_only` | Search | bool | `false` | immediate | - | show only installed packages (repo side) |
| `search.timeout_secs` | Search | number 3..=30 | `15` | immediate | - | AUR/http timeout seconds (clamped 3..=30) |
| `search.bottom_up` | Search | bool | `false` | immediate | - | print results bottom-up (AUR first); [behavior] bottom_up is a deprecated alias |
| `tui.enabled` | Advanced | bool | `true` | next-launch | - | launch the TUI when stdin/stdout are terminals |

| `gui.theme` | GUI | enum(device/system/light/dark) | `device` | next-launch | - | GUI theme: device\|system\|light\|dark (device = current behavior) |

Apply: `immediate` takes effect live where the app supports it (the TUI/GUI live-apply `[theme]` keys; `no_color` is one-way — a file can never re-enable color after `--no-color` or `NO_COLOR`), `next-launch` keys apply on relaunch. Env knobs are read-only and apply at process spawn.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `PAKMAP_NOCONFIRM` | set to 1 to skip all confirmations (makepkg/remove/refresh/upgrade/clean/flatpak) |
| `PAKMAP_TRUST_PROJECT` | set to 1 to trust ./pakmap.toml wholesale, including [behavior] writes |
| `PAKMAP_SKIP_LIVE` | set to 1 to skip live pacman/AUR integration in tests |
| `PAKMAP_GUI_SMOKE_MS` | GUI smoke-boot time budget in ms (CI canary) |
| `PAKMAP_GUI_FPBUDGET_MS` | GUI first-IPC latency budget in ms (0/unset = no budget) |

## Write policy

- `set`/`unset` write the **user file** by default (`~/.config/pakmap/config.toml`, or `--config <path>` for this session); `--target project` writes `./pakmap.toml` — which is only honored at load for the `search`/`tui`/`theme` sections unless the project layer is trusted (`PAKMAP_TRUST_PROJECT=1`), and project files are never created (only edited in place).
- Nothing is created silently: the user file is created only with `--yes` (or the GUI/TUI affordances that ask).
- Writes are atomic (temp + rename), preserve comments, spacing, and inline `# notes` (lexical line surgery on the target line only), and are guarded by a fingerprint conflict gate that refuses when the file changed on disk meanwhile.
- Value validation is the engine's: per-kind parsing, enum membership in the table order, and numeric clamps — refusals same as the table's constraints.
- `[behavior] bottom_up` is a deprecated alias of `[search] bottom_up`: reads still resolve (the same-file canonical spelling wins), writes are refused with the migration hint.
- Exit codes: `0` ok · `1` refused (policy/conflict/io/unparseable) · `2` usage (unknown key, invalid value).
